children: WhiteHawk Minerals announced a private placement of 2,873,563 Class A common shares at $26.10 per share, for expected gross proceeds of approximately $75.0 million, under a Securities Purchase Agreement signed Sep 18, 2026. Closing is expected on Sep 21, 2026, with proceeds intended to fund recently announced acquisitions and general corporate purposes. Raymond James & Associates and Stifel Nicolaus are serving as placement agents. In connection with the financing, the company entered into a Registration Rights Agreement requiring it to file a resale registration statement within 45 days of closing, seek timely SEC effectiveness, and pay up to 5.0% in liquidated damages if deadlines are missed.
